title: Grateful Dead Live at Austin Municipal Auditorium on 1972-11-22
lineage: Dat (Tascam DA-20) -> Tascam SS-R05 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard transfer of a November ’72 Texas show, though the setlist omits Promised Land.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the recording, calling the transfer great and noting the high‑quality soundboard source. The musical performance is unremarkable in the comments except for the absence of "Promised Land" despite some sources listing it, suggesting a documentation discrepancy rather than a performance issue.

ai_rating.rationale: Positive remarks about an excellent soundboard transfer outweigh the lack of detailed musical commentary; limited to two reviews, so confidence is moderate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the transfer as great with clear, balanced audio and report no technical problems.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Some sources list "Promised Land" as opening the first set, but reviewers confirm it was not performed, indicating a setlist documentation error.
